# Anthony Humphreys

Anthony Humphreys is a product-minded senior developer building useful software across AI, mobile, research, and product systems.

## Core Skills

- Product engineering from discovery through delivery and iteration.
- Applied AI systems for real workflows, including employability tooling and job matching.
- Mobile platforms, especially React Native and Expo-based student-facing services.
- Research translation: turning academic, public science, sustainability, and data projects into usable web products.
- Cloud delivery, service design, stakeholder collaboration, and maintainable engineering practices.

## Selected Work

- iLancaster: student-facing mobile platform work including Expo migration, check-in flows, digital passes, safety tooling, performance, and support visibility.
- LUCA: careers AI assistant for CV review, cover letter feedback, interview practice, job description analysis, and progress support.
- IceHunter front-end: research interface for iceberg detection outputs using map-based satellite and AI data.
- Sustainable packaging tool: web tooling for eCommerce packaging decisions across cost, compliance, and environmental impact.
- AuroraWatch UK refresh: public science platform modernisation for aurora data and alerts.
- Prob_AI research hub: public research platform using Next.js, Mantine UI, AWS, integrations, and admin workflows.
- Lexio, GMprentice, and JobMatch AI: product experiments and small SaaS offerings.
